prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full vertical native Snabbit level map, puzzle "Borrowed Passage".
Primary request: Suggest ONE elegant, compact, genuinely puzzling arrangement of existing Snabbit asteroid sprites. The lower part has a small borrowed opening in an irregular asteroid shoulder. The middle is an asymmetric Y-shaped natural hollow: the left outgoing route preserves access to a chunky reset lever, the broad tempting right route leaves it behind. Above the fork, the two paths face a different narrow crossing in an offset jagged asteroid knot. The first lever opens the low crossing but closes the upper crossing, so the player needs to take the side branch and reset before proceeding. Visually communicate a route commitment and advance planning through composition, not through a trail of gems.
Input images: Image 1 is actual source sprites and the squat heavy lever, authoritative for style/materials. Images 2-4 are the earlier actual authored packs: take irregular asymmetric clusters and airy negative space, not the regular patterns. Image 5 is the accepted previous level, showing actual rendered block scale.
Composition: tall portrait full-map view, upward travel, about 16 staggered columns and 46 rows. Start at bottom slightly right of center. A lower lopsided chunky asteroid island has a small local crossing at its right shoulder and a single yellow star just above it. One orange chunky lever sits clearly accessible before this opening. Immediately above, a second yellow star leads into a visible Y-shaped choice with an uneven thick central asteroid tongue. The left shore curls gently toward a second orange chunky lever; the right shore looks generous and open and contains a single heart, but cannot turn back to that lever. In the upper third a much smaller irregular asteroid knot contains the final narrow crossing and third yellow star. Finish is a little loose dust sparkle near top, not a horizontal stripe. Show EXACTLY TWO chunky lever objects, THREE yellow stars, ONE heart. Only two or three incidental cyan gems, never a guide trail.
Style: crisp orthographic game map with the real faceted white/gray asteroid sprites on navy empty space. Individual staggered-grid stones. Irregular chipped edges, a few little gaps and detached chips, varied densities. The silhouette resembles one broken sculpted teardrop with a forked interior, not rows of repeated rooms.
Avoid: text, labels, numbers, channel letters, colored gate markings, route lines, UI, uniform diamonds, full-width horizontal wall strips, repeated identical chambers, regular zigzags, long rail corridors, gem rails, concentric crescents, ornamental landscape outside the playfield.
